A '''fire tiara''' is a [[head slot]] item used in [[Runecraft]]. It is created at the [[Fire Altar]] by using a [[tiara]] or [[fire talisman]] on the altar with both in your inventory. This consumes the fire talisman and yields 35 Runecraft [[experience]]. Accessing the Fire Altar through [[Guardians of the Rift]] '''cannot''' be used for imbuement.

While a fire tiara is equipped, the [[mysterious ruins]] to the Fire Altar have a left-click "''Enter''" option, freeing up an inventory slot that the fire talisman would otherwise occupy.

The '''fire tiara''' counts as a warm item at [[Wintertodt]].
